# HyperUI

> Android Jetpack Compose UI component library. Read these semantic documentation pages instead of inferring APIs from the Wasm preview.

- Package: `hyper_ui`
- Maven: `com.hyperui:hyper-ui:1.0.0`
- Minimum Android SDK: 30

## Start

- [Documentation index](./index.html)
- [Getting started](./getting-started.html)
- [Theme and colors](./theme.html)
- [State and architecture](./state-model.html)
- [Component index](./component-index.html)

## Rules

- Public package: `hyper_ui`.
- Caller owns business state.
- Do not import `hyper_ui.core.*`.
- Dialogs, menus, and drawers render no scrim or overlay.
- Wasm is an interactive preview, not an API documentation source.
